services.name: Search the web

sections.title: Photos
sections.description: Back up your phone and enjoy the albums shared with you.

services.name: Pictures & albums
services.description: Back up your photos and videos, find your memories, and browse albums shared with you.

setup.label: Set up automatic phone backup
steps: Install the Immich app on your phone.
Set the server address to https://photos.newjoy.ro and sign in with your household account.
Choose the phone albums you want to back up and allow background photo access.

sections.title: Movies & TV
sections.description: Watch the household library and add movies or series. Playback needs the home network or travel WireGuard.

services.name: Movies, TV & music
services.description: Watch the household media library on phones, computers, and televisions.

setup.label: Install Emby on a device
steps: Install the Emby app on your phone, tablet, television, or streaming device.
Connect to the home Wi-Fi or travel WireGuard and add http://192.168.1.204:8096 as the server.
Sign in with your personal Emby account so watch progress and favourites stay separate.

services.name: Movie library automation
services.description: Manage films, wanted releases, downloads, and library imports.

services.name: TV library automation
services.description: Manage television series, wanted episodes, downloads, and imports.

sections.title: Passwords & account
sections.description: Keep your passwords safe and manage how you sign in.

services.name: Passwords & secure notes
services.description: Store passwords securely and fill them into websites and phone apps without memorising or reusing them.

setup.label: Install apps & browser autofill
steps: Install Bitwarden Password Manager on your phone and the Bitwarden extension in every desktop browser you use.
Before signing in, choose the self-hosted server option and enter https://vault.newjoy.ro as the server URL.
Sign in with your household vault account, then enable biometric unlock and autofill on each device.
Once Bitwarden autofill works, turn off password saving in the browser to avoid duplicate prompts.

services.name: Account & sign-in
services.description: Manage passkeys, profile details, signed-in sessions, and account activity.

setup.label: Add a passkey on this device
steps: Open your account and add a passkey for the phone or computer you are using.
Keep more than one passkey when possible so losing one device does not lock you out.
Review active sessions and remove devices you no longer use.
